hypotheses.content: Loading associations depend on scaffold, eluent and endpoint. Recent m118 measurements show a much smaller onset association at 2/1 than at 10/1. For PE-loaded m72, completion is nearly equal at 102.2 and 153.3 mg at 10/1, despite onset differences. These observations do not support a universal loading direction or a linear correction shared by both endpoints.
hypotheses.why_it_matters_for_model_learning: Many supplied predictions remain nearly loading-insensitive. Focused comparisons can teach where onset and completion need different interactions, while restricting transfer to the appropriate solvent regime.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Does m204 retain the same endpoint pattern when its 5/1-to-10/1 curve is measured at 150.15 mg, and does m119 show appreciable loading sensitivity at 2/1?

hypotheses.content: Neutral acceptor-containing scaffolds have different onset and completion transitions. The latest m28 and m98 labels establish substantial growth in their measured weak-eluent regions, whereas fluorenone retains early onset through 10/1 and iodobenzoate retains early onset at 50/1. Acceptor count or aromaticity alone cannot locate these transitions; structural explanations remain chemical priors rather than identified causes.
hypotheses.why_it_matters_for_model_learning: Solvent bridges can localize corrections instead of spreading them across oxygenated aromatics. Fused ketone, external acetyl and lactone comparisons test useful connectivity boundaries for generalization.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Where does fluorenone develop delayed onset, and do acetylfluorene, tetralone and the fused lactone follow the distinct response shapes currently predicted?

hypotheses.content: Nitrogen-containing scaffolds need connectivity- and endpoint-dependent condition responses. At 50 mg, amino-nitrile isomers have nearly equal onset at 2/1 but differ substantially at 5/1. Lutidine and quinoline show onset loading associations with smaller completion changes. The recorded methyl- versus ethyl-anthranilate contrast is another transfer boundary, although their loading conditions differ and its cause is unresolved.
hypotheses.why_it_matters_for_model_learning: These comparisons constrain nitrogen corrections to suitable connectivity and solvent regimes rather than applying one adjustment to amino, pyridyl and fused basic scaffolds.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Do quinoline's endpoint-specific loading pattern and the recorded aminoester divergence persist into the selected solvent regions, and does the lutidine midpoint interpolate smoothly?

hypotheses.content: The former proposal of a persistent positive completion association with larger loading-solvent volume remains weakened. m125 now also has a strongly nonmonotonic recorded onset series at 2/1 and DCM/500 uL: 36.23, 6.98 and 32.95 mL at 50, 100 and 150 mg. The useful remaining question concerns scaffold-, eluent- and loading-dependent recorded associations, with mechanism unresolved.
hypotheses.why_it_matters_for_model_learning: A constant volume offset or smooth mass-onset correction would misrepresent these records. The remaining pure-EA point constrains the stronger-eluent boundary of the interaction and may prevent overcorrection.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: At 150 mg and DCM/500 uL, does the pure-EA point connect to the measured 1/1-to-2/1 curve with the currently predicted modest completion?

hypotheses.content: Alcohol response curves depend on structural environment and endpoint. The latest phenylpropyl alcohol m204 curve rises sharply between 5/1 and 10/1, and methoxyphenethyl alcohol m119 is substantially retained at 5/1. Secondary alcohol m60 also shows loading-associated onset changes. Donor presence alone does not determine the transition location or interval width.
hypotheses.why_it_matters_for_model_learning: The labels test the scope of recently revealed alcohol corrections across loading and stronger eluent, helping the model learn separate onset and completion curves for different donor environments.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Does the steep m204 transition transfer across mass, and where does the stronger-eluent side of m119's elevated 5/1 response begin?

hypotheses.content: The former predicted m27 completion dip from 2/1 to 10/1 is rejected by measurement: V2 rises from 8.99 to 14.63 mL. A different recorded reversal remains, with V2 falling to 7.09 mL at 20/1 at the same loading. Its persistence across loading and farther into weak eluent is unresolved.
hypotheses.why_it_matters_for_model_learning: The model needs local response-shape repair without imposing a universal monotonicity rule. Two additional conditions test whether the compact 20/1 record represents a broader regime or localized record heterogeneity.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Does compact completion persist at 20/1 and higher loading, and what happens at 50/1 under the original lower-loading conditions?

hypotheses.content: Acrylates have distinct elution-interval shapes under their recorded conditions. Recent m21 intervals are compact at 5/1 and 20/1, while multifunctional m13 and methoxyethyl acrylate m20 have broader measured intervals. Extra acceptors do not imply broad intervals in every scaffold or solvent regime; loading and connectivity must bound transfer.
hypotheses.why_it_matters_for_model_learning: m21's large historical V2 overpredictions reveal a completion-specific repair target. Related ether and cyclic acrylate curves can teach where interval expansion belongs and prevent indiscriminate transfer from m13.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Does m21's interval expand at lower loading or 50/1, and do the m20 and m15 bridges confirm different transition and completion shapes?

hypotheses.content: At fixed 114.6 mg and PE loading, m197 currently predicts a pronounced completion decrease from 1/1 to 2/1 with little onset change. This may reflect an uncovered condition interaction or interpolation failure. Neither a true dip nor a prediction error has been established at these two conditions.
hypotheses.why_it_matters_for_model_learning: A small matched experiment can resolve a specific shape warning in a hydroxy-aldehyde region while preserving genuine recorded nonmonotonicity elsewhere.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Does measured completion actually decrease between 1/1 and 2/1 when all recorded loading conditions are fixed?

feedback_interpretation: The latest outcomes strengthen the need for localized corrections and structural transfer boundaries. Historical completion underpredictions were large for m28 at 10/1 (33.55 mL), m119 at 5/1 (29.91 mL), m204 at 10/1 (26.88 mL), and m98 at 50/1 (18.85 mL). Conversely, m201 at 50/1, iodobenzoate onset, fluorenone onset, and m21 completion rejected broad delayed-elution predictions. I therefore pair extensions of steep curves with early-onset and compact-interval boundaries. The new m125 point was underpredicted by about 19 mL at both endpoints and establishes a nonmonotonic recorded onset association across its 500 uL mass series; I do not infer an adsorption mechanism. m118's 2/1 mass pair changes onset by only about 0.72 mL and completion by -2.88 mL, much less than its 10/1 onset contrast, narrowing the scope of the previous loading hypothesis. PE-loaded m72 has nearly equal completion at 102.2 and 153.3 mg at 10/1, and nearly equal completion at 51.1 and 102.2 mg at 20/1, despite onset differences. Its next 5/1 point tests where that pattern begins. The amino-nitrile 2/1 comparison confirms similar lower-mass onset, so another nearby positional label has reduced immediate value. The m115 1/1 result and 162 mg pair further localize its elevated 5/1 region; their generally smaller errors reduce the priority of more adjacent m115 rows. Finally, m27 measurements reject the previously predicted 2/1-to-10/1 completion dip but reveal a separate measured decrease at 20/1. All errors quoted here are acquisition-time errors, not current-model residuals.
batch_rationale: The 32 rows span 20 scaffolds, with repeated molecules serving specific comparisons. The m28 and m204 experiments test transfer of newly revealed steep curves across loading; the m119 points constrain the stronger-eluent side and loading scope of another large failure. Fluorenone, iodobenzoate and naphthylacetate bridges distinguish early onset from delayed onset while learning completion growth separately. Acetylfluorene, tetralone and the fused lactone extend these questions to meaningful carbonyl-connectivity boundaries. The acrylate comparisons address m21's completion-specific failures and test whether compact or broader intervals generalize to suitable neighboring structures. Nitrogen experiments fill a loading midpoint, complete a quinoline loading series and explore aminoester boundaries after the amino-nitrile solvent-localization question was answered. The m125 point constrains a recorded feature interaction, while m27 and salicylaldehyde receive limited, explicit shape checks. Together, these labels can improve interpolation, identify transition locations and restrict overcorrection across other rows sharing structural and condition features. CW distance supports several exploratory choices but does not determine the batch. Single-predictor quantile spans are not treated as calibrated epistemic uncertainty, and V2 minus V1 is used only as the elution interval width. Unrecorded experimental factors and possible record heterogeneity limit causal interpretation.
